description_en: Query call details by instance ID.
description_zh: 根据实例ID查询通话详情
kebab_example: aliyun aiccs hotline-session-query --instance-id ccc_xp_pre-cn-000 --acid 77197860000 --call-type 1 --called-number 1356150000 --calling-number 0571770000 --group-id 123456 --group-name '自动化技能组' --member-id 78560000 --member-name '匿名会员' --query-end-time 1614829721 --query-start-time 1614828721 --request-id EE338D98-9BD3-4413-B165 --servicer-name '刘测试' --servicer-id 555555 --params xxxx --page-size 10 --page-no 1 --call-result normal --id acc1c58dab4a400000e3813c66 --acid-list 7719786 --call-type-list 1 --group-id-list 123456 --calling-number-list 05717730000 --called-number-list 1356150000 --member-id-list 7856876 --servicer-id-list 555555 --call-result-list normal --api-version 2019-10-15 --region cn-hangzhou
name: HotlineSessionQuery

parameters.help_en:
AICCS instance ID.  
You can obtain it in the Instance Management section of the left-side navigation pane in the Artificial Intelligence Cloud Call Service console (https://aiccs.console.aliyun.com/overview)
parameters.help_zh: AICCS实例ID。 您可以在智能联络中心控制台 (https://aiccs.console.aliyun.com/overview)左侧导航栏的实例管理中获取
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en: Session ID. The acid received via WebSocket after an inbound call
parameters.name: acid

parameters.help_en:
Call Type. Valid values:
1: Outbound call.
2: Inbound call.
3: Change owner
parameters.help_zh:
电话类型。取值：
1：外呼。
2：入呼。
3：转交
parameters.name: call_type

parameters.help_en: Calling party number, such as a user's phone number, agent number, or machine number
parameters.help_zh: 发起方号码。例如用户手机号码、客服坐席号码、机器号码等
parameters.name: called_number

parameters.help_en: Calling party number, such as a user's phone number, customer service agent number, or machine number
parameters.help_zh: 接听方号码。例如用户手机号码、客服坐席号码、机器号码等
parameters.name: calling_number

parameters.help_en: Page size. The value must be greater than 0. Default value: 20
parameters.help_zh: 每页大小。取值大于0，默认值：20
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: Current page number. The value must be greater than 0. Default Value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 当前页。取值大于0，默认值：1
parameters.name: page_no

parameters.help_en:
Call result. Valid values:  

normal: Normal hang-up.  
touchRouteError: Queue hang-up.  
touchInQueue: Queue hang-up.  
touchInLoss: Queue hang-up.  
userHangup: User hang-up or IVR hang-up.  
sysHangup: System hang-up or IVR hang-up.  
transferAgent: User hang-up or IVR hang-up.  
dailing: Agent hang-up during ringing.  
TouchRingCallLoss: Queue hang-up during ringing
parameters.help_zh:
呼叫结果。取值：

normal：正常挂机。
touchRouteError：队列挂机。
touchInQueue：队列挂机。
touchInLoss：队列挂机。
userHangup：用户挂机，IVR挂机。
sysHangup：系统挂机，IVR挂机。
transferAgent：用户挂机，IVR挂机。
dailing：客服挂机，振铃挂机。
TouchRingCallLoss：队列挂机，振铃挂机
parameters.name: call_result

parameters.help_en: Global unique ID (GUID) of the call detail
parameters.name: id

Code.description_en: Status code. A value of "Success" indicates that the request succeeded
Code.description_zh: 状态码。返回Success表示请求成功

Acid.description_en: Session ID. The acid in WebSocket after an incoming call

ActiveTransferId.description_en:
Agent ID.  

This field is null in non–change owner scenarios.
ActiveTransferId.description_zh:
坐席ID。
非转交场景数据为Null

CallContinueTime.description_en:
Call duration, in seconds.  

Unconnected calls do not include call duration.
CallContinueTime.description_zh:
通话时长。单位：秒。

未接通场景无通话时长

CallResult.description_en:
Call result. Valid values:

normal: Normal hang-up.
touchRouteError: Queue hang-up.
touchInQueue: Queue hang-up.
touchInLoss: Queue hang-up.
userHangup: User hang-up or IVR hang-up.
sysHangup: System hang-up or IVR hang-up.
transferAgent: User hang-up or IVR hang-up.
dailing: Agent hang-up or ring-off hang-up.
TouchRingCallLoss: Queue hang-up or ring-off hang-up
CallResult.description_zh:
呼叫结果。取值：

normal：正常挂机。
touchRouteError：队列挂机。
touchInQueue：队列挂机。
touchInLoss：队列挂机。
userHangup：用户挂机，IVR挂机。
sysHangup：系统挂机，IVR挂机。
transferAgent：用户挂机，IVR挂机。
dailing：客服挂机，振铃挂机。
TouchRingCallLoss：队列挂机，振铃挂机

CallType.description_en:
Call type. Valid values:
1: Outbound call
2: Inbound call
3: Change owner
CallType.description_zh:
呼叫类型。取值：
1：外呼
2：入呼
3：转交

CallingNumber.description_en: Calling party number, such as a user's phone number, agent number, or machine number
CallingNumber.description_zh: 发起方号码。例如用户手机号码、客服坐席号码、机器号码等

CreateTime.description_en:
Call creation time.

In outbound scenarios, this is the time when the outbound call was initiated.
In inbound scenarios, this is the time when the call entered the ACC system
CreateTime.description_zh:
通话创建时间。

外呼场景为外呼发起时间。
入呼场景为通话进入ACC系统时间

EvaluationLevel.description_en:
Satisfaction rating, indicated by star level. Valid values:

2: Two-star satisfaction
3: Three-star satisfaction
4: Four-star satisfaction
5: Five-star satisfaction

This field has no data in outbound scenarios or scenarios where the call was not answered
EvaluationLevel.description_zh:
满意度，评价星级。取值：

2：二级满意度
3：三级满意度
4：四级满意度
5：五级满意度

外呼场景和未接通场景无数据

EvaluationScore.description_en:
Satisfaction score. Valid values:
1: Very dissatisfied
2: Dissatisfied
3: Neutral
4: Satisfied
5: Very satisfied

This field has no data in outbound scenarios or scenarios where the call was not answered
EvaluationScore.description_zh:
满意度-评价得分。取值：
1：非常不满意
2：不满意
3：一般
4：满意
5：非常满意

外呼场景和未接通场景无数据

GroupId.description_en:
Skill group ID.  

When CallType is 1, outbound call scenarios do not include skill group information.
GroupId.description_zh:
技能组ID。

当CallType取值为1时，外呼场景无技能组信息

GroupName.description_en:
Skill group name.  
When CallType is 1, outbound call scenarios do not include skill group information
GroupName.description_zh:
技能组名称。
当CallType取值为1时，外呼场景无技能组信息

HangUpRole.description_en:
Party that hung up. Valid values:  

1: System hung up  
2: Customer hung up  
3: Agent hung up  
null: Unknown
HangUpRole.description_zh:
挂机方。取值：

1：系统挂机
2：客户挂机
3：客服挂机
null：未知

Id.description_en: The GUID of the call detail record

InQueueTime.description_en:
Time when the call entered the queue for assignment.  

Outbound call scenarios do not include queue entry time.
InQueueTime.description_zh:
热线分配-入队时间。
外呼场景无入队时间

OutQueueTime.description_en:
The time when the hotline call is assigned and dequeued.

Outbound scenarios do not have a dequeue time
OutQueueTime.description_zh:
热线分配出队时间。

外呼场景无出队时间

PassiveTransferId.description_en:
Agent ID. The phone number to which the call is transferred.
This field is null in non-transfer scenarios
PassiveTransferId.description_zh:
坐席ID。转交电话号码。
非转交场景数据为Null

PassiveTransferIdType.description_en:
The recipient of the transferred session. Valid values:
1: Agent ID.
2: Transferred phone number.

This field is null in non-transfer scenarios
PassiveTransferIdType.description_zh:
会话被转交方。取值：
1：坐席ID。
2：转交电话号码。

非转交场景数据为Null

PickUpTime.description_en: The time when the call is answered

RingContinueTime.description_en:
Ringing duration, in seconds.

Outbound scenarios do not have ringing duration
RingContinueTime.description_zh:
振铃时长。单位：秒。

外呼场景无振铃时间

RingEndTime.description_en:
The time when ringing ends.

Outbound scenarios do not have a ring end time
RingEndTime.description_zh:
振铃结束时间。

外呼场景无振铃结束时间

RingStartTime.description_en:
Ringing start time.  

Outbound call scenarios do not include ringing start time.
RingStartTime.description_zh:
振铃开始时间。

外呼场景无振铃开始时间

ServicerId.description_en:
Agent ID.  
In inbound scenarios, agent information is unavailable until the call is assigned to an agent
ServicerId.description_zh:
坐席ID。
呼入场景未分配到到坐席之前无坐席信息

ServicerName.description_en:
Agent name.
Agent information is unavailable before the call is assigned to an agent in inbound scenarios
ServicerName.description_zh:
坐席名称。
呼入场景未分配到到坐席之前无坐席信息

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the API call succeeded
